title: ResolvedTokens
description: Design tokens for one theme mode after layering (engine, preset, instance, config overrides) and alias resolution. Written by @pulseai/tokens; read by the site and by `pulse tokens check`.

extensions.title: TokenExtensions
extensions.description: The org.pulseai entry of a token's $extensions.

contrast_against.description: Surface tokens this (text) color must reach quality.text_contrast_min against.

distinct.title: DistinctMember
distinct.description: Membership in a set of colors that must stay distinguishable. With order on every member, only neighbours are compared (categorical chart order); otherwise every pair is.

override.description: Key of config.theme.overrides that replaces this token's value.

fontsource.description: Fontsource package that provides this font family.
